Name: DEBUG
Description: if we don't find a tag, we apply this fall back tag, and report that shape to debug console so dev can see that...

Name: Hard Collision
Description: Hard Defined Boundaries to Stop anything beyond...

Name: Soft Collision
Description: Normal Collision that are used to Block Player Hitbox for normal things like walls, fences, etc...

Name: Spawn
Description: Tag a pointer to make it act as spawn point.

Name: Light Source
Description: Used to Tag shapes that acts as light sources

Name: Light Zone
Description: For Shapes that Act as Where Light from light source hit.

Name: Beach Water
Description: Denotes The Beach Water which player can  Walk on (Ocean Water can't be walked on, so Beach Acts as Shallow Water before We stop player movement). Also We apply Sink Effect to player sprite to Indicate shallowness, And also we need to apply a Ocean Waves Effect to this shape with this tag

Name: Grass
Description: Use to spawn default green grass

Name: Farm
Description: Denotes area where player can till, farm, etc...

Name: Tree
Description: Mark Trees that grows wild, can be chopped

Name: Dead Tree
Description: Mark tree that are have fallen, and Dead. Often rots with mushrooms
